name: Open States people (bulk)
notes: Collected 2026-08. 7435 addresses over 52 jurisdictions; 232 personal (158 free-mail, 74 self-managed campaign domains). The wikidata column exists in the CSV but is empty for all 7453 rows, so these rows carry no person key. Required eight anchored US patterns in get_gov_patterns(); before them 682 legislature addresses on .us/.org/.net/.com were misread as personal.
